links.outcome: Prospective performance of CPT code extraction model on new operative notes after retrospective validation
links.effect: Prospective testing on 268 notes (May-October 2024) confirmed strong real-world performance, consistent with cross-validation AUPRC of 0.976 (compact) and 0.981 (large).
links.quote: Prospective testing on 268 notes confirmed strong real-world performance.

unlisted_practices: Open-architecture, transparent AI model for surgical CPT coding
Expert medical coder review to establish a reference standard for coding

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates a transformer LLM (GatorTron) for automated CPT coding from operative notes, but only evaluates model predictive performance without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
